## Summary

Describe the change and the boundary it affects.

## Validation

List the exact commands and gates run. Attach only redacted, redistributable logs.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not rewrite preserved history.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant UP, SMP, pmap, process, or ABI tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, generated binaries, or proprietary material were added.
- [ ] Existing copyright and APSL notices are preserved.
- [ ] New or modified CaribeOS files carry the appropriate license notice.
